description:
The 2026-06-01 clickhouse-server corpus rerun fixed the platform wipeout and
exposed a small tail that should not block the higher-impact loader, DDL, and
query-compatibility follow-ups.

Corpus evidence:
  - Matrix: `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_clickhouse_server_rc1_corpus_20260601/matrix_summary.tsv`
  - Cells: `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_clickhouse_server_rc1_corpus_20260601/cells.jsonl`

Tail failures:
  - JoinOrder SF=1 failed before ClickHouse execution because the external data archive URL returned 404:
    `https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/releases/download/data%2Fjoinorder-imdb-2013-v1/joinorder-imdb-2013-v1.tar.zst`.
    RESOLVED 2026-07-09: shared data availability, not a ClickHouse adapter
    issue. The release asset was restored (logical-mode republish) under
    joinorder-canonical-release-asset-restore; the URL now returns 200. w1 is
    answered — re-run the JoinOrder cell to clear this tail failure.
  - TPCHavoc SF=1 timed out after 1200s with no subprocess output captured.
  - FlightData SF=1 timed out after 1200s with no subprocess output captured.

These failures need separate triage because one appears to be shared data
availability rather than ClickHouse adapter behavior, and the two timeouts
may change after loader/query fixes reduce earlier failure modes. A follow-up
review confirmed JoinOrder should stay deferred here rather than folded into
ClickHouse query dialect work.

anti_patterns.dont: globally prune JoinOrder from UAT because one release asset URL failed.
spend first effort on SF1 timeout tuning while smaller-scale loader and query failures are still active.
use Docker prune or broad cleanup as part of timeout triage.

deferrals.reason: The item explicitly forbids broad SF1 Docker sweeps before high-impact loader/query blockers are fixed. Query-compatibility w5 is still claimed and blocked on an operator release window; running TPCHavoc and FlightData SF1 now would be high-resource, low-signal work.
deferrals.summary: SF1 timeout retests remain deferred behind ClickHouse query compatibility and operator resources

preserves.behavior: Do not classify JoinOrder data 404 as a ClickHouse-server adapter failure without a cross-platform check.
Do not raise global UAT timeouts to hide long-running SF1 cells.
Do not start broad SF1 Docker sweeps until high-impact loader and query blockers are fixed.
